declarations.type:
∀ {PolicyDigest : Type} (system : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.ReconfigurationSystem)
  (ledger :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.ReconfigurationVoteLedger system PolicyDigest)
  (old : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.ConfigurationCertificate system PolicyDigest)
  (joint :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.JointConfigurationCertificate system PolicyDigest),
  old.term = joint.term →
    old.index = joint.index →
      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.OldCertificateValid system ledger old →
        ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.JointCertificateValid system ledger joint →
          old.receipt = joint.receipt
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.old_certificate_and_joint_certificate_same_slot_agree

      ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinJointConfiguration.NewCertificateValid system ledger new →

          new.receipt = joint.receipt
